name: terminal-v4
description: Browser-based terminal workspace with a React frontend and Rust API runtime, providing PTY sessions, preview tooling, and Claude Code integration.

scripts.app:build: npm run frontend:build && cargo build -p terminal-v4-api --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml
scripts.test: npm run rust:test && npm run frontend:test
scripts.verify: npm run rust:fmt:check && npm run rust:check && npm run rust:test && npm run frontend:test && npm run frontend:build
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:install && npm run desktop:prepare && npm run desktop:predev && npm --prefix desktop/tauri run tauri dev -- --no-dev-server-wait
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:install && npm run desktop:prepare && npm run desktop:predev && npm --prefix desktop/tauri run tauri build
